messages.content:
Title: Diagnosis
Details: 
The failing test case `testReadWinZipArchive()` tries to read a zip file created by WinZip that contains Unicode extra fields. The reported issue is that `ZipFile.getInputStream()` returns null for entries obtained from `ZipFile.getEntry()` or `ZipFile.getEntries()` when dealing with Unicode extra fields.

By inspecting the `ZipFile` constructor called in the test (`ZipFile(File, String, boolean)`), it initializes fields and calls `populateFromCentralDirectory()` and `resolveLocalFileHeaderData()`.

The `populateFromCentralDirectory()` method reads central directory entries and for each one, calls `readCentralDirectoryEntry()`. This method decodes entry names and comments using the specified encoding or UTF-8 if the UTF-8 flag is set. It then stores entries in `nameMap` and a map `entries`, and collects entries without UTF-8 flags (which may have Unicode extra fields) into `noUTF8Flag`.

The `resolveLocalFileHeaderData()` method seeks to local file headers of entries and reads the local extra fields, setting these in the corresponding `ZipArchiveEntry`. Then, for entries in `entriesWithoutUTF8Flag`, it attempts to override the name and comment using `ZipUtil.setNameAndCommentFromExtraFields()`, which tries to decode Unicode extra fields (UnicodePathExtraField and UnicodeCommentExtraField) if the CRC matches the original fields.

Despite this handling, the test fails because `ZipFile.getInputStream()` returns null. `getInputStream()` returns null if the entry is not found in the internal map `entries`. The internal map keys are `ZipArchiveEntry` instances, so if the entry returned from `getEntry()` does not match (in terms of object identity or hashcode) the one in `entries`, the lookup fails, returning null input stream.

The suspicious point is in `resolveLocalFileHeaderData()`: since `ZipArchiveEntry`'s hashCode depends on the entry name, changing the entry name (if Unicode extra field overrides it) after the map key insertion can cause a mismatch. This mutability issue leads to entries being not found in `entries` map after name changes, resulting in `getInputStream()` returning null.

In sum, the bug arises because the name of `ZipArchiveEntry` objects is changed after they are inserted as keys in data structures relying on their hashCode, causing lookup failures later. This is triggered by processing Unicode extra fields for entries without UTF-8 flags in WinZip-created archives.

This detailed chain of logic from reading entries, setting Unicode names and comments, to lookups explains why reading WinZip archives with Unicode extra fields and the specified flags fails when trying to get input streams for entries.

Next, the fix should address this mutability issue of ZipArchiveEntry objects used as map keys or consider alternative data structures.

Which methods would you like me to suggest for fixing this?

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
